newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson Multimedia losses deepen in Q1 - Le Monde.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Multimedia losses deepen in Q1 - Le Monde.

text.p: Thomson Multimedia, the consumer electronics subsidiary of Thomson SS, lost 710 million francs in the first quarter of 1997 while it had budgeted for a loss of 740 million for the first half, newspaper Le Monde said.
The afternoon daily said new chairman Thierry Breton was taking cost-cutting measures to return to break-even at the end of the year.
Le Monde said Breton had told a supervisory board meeting on Tuesday that no rival had deposited complaints against a planned 11 billion franc recapitalisation of the group.
Philips Electronics NV had been weighing its options to complain to the European Union against the state aid.
